recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not reintroduce a shared Questionnaire/ElementDefinition item structure or edit retired DataElement source for this issue; future Questionnaire.item.definition changes should be handled under their own Questionnaire trackers.
issue_request: The Published/Not Persuasive with Modification issue asked whether Questionnaire should use ElementDefinition too, as part of a shared StructureDefinition/DataElement/Questionnaire structure. The approved resolution said not to create such a shared structure because StructureDefinition and DataElement already shared ElementDefinition while Questionnaire differed and could map items to DataElements; the source action was to remove the DSTU/STU comment.
initial_application: Historical commit 47cf96aa02e8bf8507221108c41aa24eda5a8e02, whose subject included [#11322], removed the STU note asking whether StructureDefinition, Questionnaire, and DataElement should share a structure from source/dataelement/dataelement-introduction.xml.
additional_context: Current source/fhir.ini comments out DataElement resource entries, so the historical DataElement page is no longer an active build target. Current Questionnaire source has Questionnaire.item.definition as a URI to ElementDefinition or ObservationDefinition and explanatory notes about deriving selected values from ElementDefinition. Later Published Questionnaire trackers FHIR-12186 and FHIR-13900 support this design without turning Questionnaire.item into a shared ElementDefinition structure. Zulip discussion from September 2016 confirms the background confusion among Questionnaire, DataElement, and ElementDefinition, and no direct FHIR-11322 Zulip or Confluence conflict was found.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch. No source files were changed because the approved source action is already applied and the only historical DataElement source location is outside the current build.

related_jiras.note: Added Questionnaire.item.definition as a URI reference to an ElementDefinition and removed older data-element-reference extension direction, explaining how definitions can inform Questionnaire items without making the item structure itself shared.
Clarified that inferred details from Questionnaire.item.definition do not remove the need for explicit Questionnaire fields, supporting the current separation from ElementDefinition structure.
